checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; no test selection
loss: map MSE + global mean MSE + 0.1 * measurement MSE
input_policy: UWA /255, CAVE /65535 then each cube rescaled to grand mean 0.2; dimensionless pseudo-scene, not radiometric harmonization
illumination: flat 21-bin spectrum; all weights one; no measured absolute efficiency
noise: noiseless main; additive Gaussian at 1 percent train measurement RMS sensitivity only

augmentation.border: zero; transformed source corners must remain inside canvas

test_policy: frozen UWA groups; CAVE scene-disjoint; no test augmentation, fitting or tuning
